```artifact
Feature: Alarms in GUI

  Scenario: Compute and trigger LOW VTI alarm
    Given the VTI threshold is set to 15
    When the VTI for the current breath is 20
    Then a "LOW VTI" alarm should be triggered
    And the alarm should be of medium priority

  Scenario: Compute and trigger HIGH VTI alarm
    Given the VTI threshold is set to 25
    When the VTI for the current breath is 30
    Then a "HIGH VTI" alarm should be triggered
    And the alarm should be of medium priority

  Scenario: Compute and trigger LOW VTE alarm
    Given the VTE threshold is set to 10
    When the VTE for the current breath is 15
    Then a "LOW VTE" alarm should be triggered

  Scenario: Set threshold for LOW VTI alarm
    Given the GUI has a control for setting the threshold for the LOW VTI alarm
    When the threshold is set to 20
    Then the threshold should be updated to 20

  Scenario: Set threshold for LOW VTI alarm with invalid value
    Given the GUI has a control for setting the threshold for the LOW VTI alarm
    When the threshold is set to -5
    Then an error message should be displayed

  Scenario: Set threshold for LOW VTI alarm with boundary value
    Given the GUI has a control for setting the threshold for the LOW VTI alarm
    When the threshold is set to 0
    Then the threshold should be updated to 0

  Scenario: Compute VTI for each breath
    Given the GUI can compute VTI for each breath
    When a breath is completed
    Then the VTI for that breath should be computed and displayed

  Scenario Outline: Set threshold for LOW VTI alarm with various values
    Given the GUI has a control for setting the threshold for the LOW VTI alarm
    When the threshold is set to <threshold>
    Then the threshold should be updated to <threshold>

    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 15        |
      | 20        |
      | 25        |
      | 10        |
      | 30        |
      | 5         |
```
